# Kamruzzaman Polash

> Custom software engineer and Laravel backend architect based in Bangladesh, working remotely with teams in France, the UK, the US, and worldwide since 2022. Builds multi-tenant SaaS platforms, multi-branch POS & inventory systems, WooCommerce/Shopify sync engines, automated courier & payment pipelines (Pathao, Steadfast, bKash, SSLCommerz, Stripe), and production AI/LLM workflows using Laravel 13, PHP 8.4, MySQL, Redis, Docker, and Kubernetes.

## Engineering Blog — Laravel Architecture & Security

- [Laravel Middleware vs FormRequest vs Policy vs Resource (Laravel 13)](https://polash.link/blog/laravel-middleware-form-request-policy-resource/): 5-layer API security lifecycle in Laravel 13 covering `bootstrap/app.php` without `Kernel.php`, `SecurityHeaders`, 404 vs 403 IDOR prevention, atomic `DB::transaction()` file handling, and PHP 8 `match (true)` exceptions.
- [CVE-2026-109618 (PHP2Shell RCE): How It Works & How to Fix It](https://polash.link/blog/php-rce-cve-2026-109618-fix/): CVSS 9.2 unauthenticated PHP multipart parser RCE breakdown, safe versions (8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, 8.2.35), and Ubuntu, Docker, and cPanel patch steps.
- [Laravel 13 New Features & PHP 8.3 Requirements](https://polash.link/blog/laravel-13-new-features/): Complete guide to Laravel 13 requirements, PHP model attributes, `Cache::touch()`, Reverb database driver, passkeys, and zero-downtime upgrade steps.
- [Laravel Sanctum vs JWT: Which Should You Use for API Auth?](https://polash.link/blog/laravel-api-authentication-jwt-sanctum/): Technical comparison of opaque database tokens vs stateless bearer JWTs, revocation trade-offs, and hybrid auth patterns.
- [Laravel Sanctum Tutorial: API Auth Step by Step](https://polash.link/blog/laravel-sanctum-tutorial/): Installing Sanctum, protecting API routes, token abilities, SPA cookie auth, and instant revocation.
- [Laravel REST API: Auth & Best Practices Guide](https://polash.link/blog/laravel-rest-api-best-practices/): Versioning, Spatie permissions, rate limiting, validation, and consistent JSON error envelopes.
- [MVCS Architecture in Laravel, Explained](https://polash.link/blog/laravel-mvcs-architecture-guide/): Keeping controllers thin by moving domain logic into testable Service classes.
- [Laravel Observer Pattern: Audit Logging Done Right](https://polash.link/blog/laravel-observer-pattern-audit-log/): Implementing immutable audit trails with Eloquent Observers vs MySQL triggers.
- [Single-Database vs Multi-Database SaaS Multi-Tenancy](https://polash.link/blog/single-vs-multi-database-saas-multitenancy/): Cost, data isolation, migrations, and compliance trade-offs for SaaS founders and architects.
- [Laravel 12.39: @hasStack, Route Filtering & More](https://polash.link/blog/laravel-12-39-new-features/): Breakdown of `@hasStack`, route filtering improvements, and core updates.
- [PHP Coding Standards Every Developer Should Follow](https://polash.link/blog/php-coding-standards-bangladesh-developers/): PSR-12, PSR-4, strict types, Pint, and PHPStan practices for engineering teams.

## Engineering Blog — Performance, Queues, Realtime & DevOps

- [I Tested the Doppar PHP Framework: Benchmarks & Architecture Review](https://polash.link/blog/doppar-php-framework-review/): Real-world `wrk` concurrency benchmarks, queue stress tests, and memory profiling compared to Laravel.
- [Laravel Queue vs defer(): When to Use Each](https://polash.link/blog/laravel-queue-vs-defer/): Execution order, memory behavior, database transaction gotchas, and decision matrix for Laravel 11–13.
- [Laravel Queue Workers in Docker: Why They Die & How to Fix It](https://polash.link/blog/laravel-queue-worker-docker-production/): Supervisor config, `--max-time`, `--max-jobs`, SIGTERM handling, OOM kills, and Horizon vs `queue:work`.
- [Laravel Queues & Jobs with Redis: Production Guide](https://polash.link/blog/laravel-queues-jobs-redis-horizon/): Batching, Redis Horizon auto-scaling, failure handling, and worker supervision.
- [Laravel Realtime in 2026: Reverb vs Pusher vs Ably](https://polash.link/blog/laravel-realtime-notifications-pusher-fcm-soketi/): Pricing breakdown, latency comparison, self-hosted Reverb/Soketi setup, and Laravel Echo integration.
- [Building a White-Label Real-Time Live Chat with Ably and Telegram Topics](https://polash.link/blog/white-label-live-chat-ably-telegram/): Zero-tracker WebSocket live chat routed 1:1 to Telegram Forum Topics.
- [Laravel Performance Optimisation Guide](https://polash.link/blog/laravel-performance-optimization/): Caching strategy, Redis tuning, eager loading, OPcache, and query profiling.
- [MySQL Query Optimisation in Laravel](https://polash.link/blog/mysql-query-optimization-laravel/): Eliminating N+1 queries, composite index design, reading `EXPLAIN` plans, and stopping full table scans.
- [Deploy Laravel with Docker & Kubernetes](https://polash.link/blog/laravel-docker-kubernetes-deployment/): Multi-stage Docker builds, PHP-FPM/Nginx tuning, health checks, and zero-downtime Kubernetes rollouts.
